title: Horizontal GR self-correlation and controlled E006 placement
hypothesis: Same-well visible-prefix GR fingerprints can identify local structural direction independently of typewell matching and add stable value to E006 after strictly cross-fitted placement.

design.independent_leg: same-well horizontal GR self-correlation over visible-prefix structural slopes
legal_inputs: frozen E006 averaged OOF path as cross-fitted anchor
forbidden_inputs: actual hidden TVT in candidate construction or threshold selection
typewell GR/TVT in the self-correlation leg
design.visible_only_design: Absolute residual transfer was rejected. Five-neighbor local U-slope fingerprints and a 0.10 fixed reference were selected using only pseudo-boundaries inside the visible prefix at 0.65, 0.75, and 0.85.
design.promotion: A legal placement must gain at least 0.03 RMSE over E006 and 0.45 over last-known, win at least four maps and 17 outer cells, satisfy tail and special-slice limits, improve every spatial/typewell evaluator group, prove independent residual structure, and pass all control, stability, runtime, memory, identity, and reproduction gates.
design.deployment: Package and private Kaggle parity only after statistical promotion. No leaderboard submission is authorized.
